stanlee.name: * Stan Lee
stanlee.text: Stan Lee has the text boxes of each hero used with the Marvelous ability. (Stan Lee is for fun. If something feels like it should work, it does!) "Excelsior!"

stanlee.name: * Stan Lee
stanlee.text: Stan Lee has the text boxes of each alter-ego used with the Marvelous ability. Marvelous — During deck-building, your deck must include 15 hero-specific cards from among other hero sets in your collection.

rainy.name: * Hulk
rainy.text: Anger — Response: After Hulk takes damage, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

rainy.name: * Bruce Banner
rainy.text: Bring Out The Big Guy — Interrupt: When an enemy would scheme, spend a [physical] resource → change to your hero form. That enemy attacks you instead.

rainy.name: * Black Widow
rainy.subtitle: Natasha Romanoff
rainy.text: [star] Response: After Black Widow thwarts, remove 1 threat from another scheme. Hero Action: Exhaust Black Widow → flip to your alter-ego form.

rainy.name: Brilliant Mind
rainy.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you paid for this card using only [mental] resources, choose to either remove 2 additional threat from that scheme or confuse an enemy.

rainy.name: Hulk Smash
rainy.text: Hero Action: Make the following attacks against the same target: • (attack): Deal 3 damage. • (attack): Deal 3 damage. • (attack): Deal 3 damage.

rainy.name: Interception
rainy.text: Hero Interrupt: When a treachery is revealed, take 2 damage → cancel all of its effects and discard it. If you overpaid for this card with a [energy] or [physical] resource, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

rainy.name: Reckless Charge
rainy.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to Hulk → deal 3 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [physical] resource, this attack gains overkill.

rainy.name: Natural Genius
rainy.text: Spend this card only in alter-ego form.

rainy.name: Unnatural Strength
rainy.text: Spend this card only in hero form.

rainy.name: The Other Guy
rainy.text: Alter-Ego Response (thwart): After you change form, remove 1 threat from a scheme. (Limit once per phase.) Hero Response (attack): After you change form, deal 1 damage to an enemy. (Limit once per phase.)

rainy.name: Intimidating Roar
rainy.text: Hero Response (thwart): After Hulk takes damage from an attack, exhaust Intimidating Roar → remove 1 threat from a scheme (2 threat instead if you took 3 or more damage).

rainy.name: Limitless Endurance
rainy.text: You get +3 hit points and Bruce Banner gets +1 REC. Hero Action: Exhaust Limitless Endurance → heal 1 damage from Hulk.

rainy.name: Limitless Strength
rainy.text: Hulk gets +1 ATK. Hero Resource: Exhaust Limitless Strength → generate a [physical] resource.

rainy.name: * Rescue
rainy.text: Rapid Responder — [star] Response: After you use your basic DEF, make a basic thwart or attack without exhausting Rescue.

rainy.name: * Pepper Potts
rainy.subtitle: Executive
rainy.text: Executive — Action: Each player may discard 1 card from their hand to search their deck for a [[TECH]] upgrade and add it to their hand. (Limit once per round.)

rainy.name: * Iron Man
rainy.subtitle: Tony Stark
rainy.text: [star] Interrupt: When Iron Man uses a basic power, spend 1 resource of any type → Iron Man gets +2 to that basic power for that use.

rainy.name: Magnetic Restraints
rainy.text: Hero Action: Choose one: • Stun an enemy. • Choose an attachment with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response" and discard it.

rainy.name: Repulsor Blasts
rainy.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged. Spend X [energy] resources (to a maximum of 3) → repeat this attack X times against targets of your choosing.

rainy.name: Responsive
rainy.text: Hero Response: After you use a basic power, ready Rescue. You get +1 to a basic power of your choice (THW, ATK or DEF) until the end of the round.

rainy.name: Search and Rescue
rainy.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If there is a crisis icon in play, remove 2 additional threat from that scheme and this thwart ignores the crisis icon.

rainy.name: * Stark Resilient
rainy.text: Resource: Exhaust Stark Resilient → generate a [wild] resource for any player.

rainy.name: First Responder
rainy.text: Uses (3 medical counters). Hero Response: After another character takes damage, exhaust this card and remove 1 medical counter from it → heal 1 damage from that character (2 damage instead if they are an identity).

rainy.name: Magnetic Deflector
rainy.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, discard the top card of your deck → that enemy gets -1 ATK for that attack. (Limit twice per round.)

rainy.name: * Model V Chassis
rainy.text: You get +3 hit points. Hero Response: After you defend and take no damage, exhaust Model V Chassis and spend 1 resource of any type → give Rescue a tough status card.

rainy.name: * Model V Helmet
rainy.text: Rescue gets +1 THW and ignores the patrol keyword. Hero Response (thwart): After a side scheme enters play, exhaust Model V Helmet → remove 1 threat from that scheme (2 threat instead if a crisis icon is in play).

rainy.name: Repulsor Gauntlets
rainy.text: Rescue gets +1 ATK. Hero Interrupt: When Rescue makes a basic attack, exhaust Repulsor Gauntlets → that attack gains ranged.

rainy.name: Board Meeting
rainy.text: Give to the Pepper Potts player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Pepper Potts → remove Board Meeting from the game. • Discard 1 [[TECH]] upgrade you control. If no upgrade was discarded this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

rainy.name: Helicopter Crash
rainy.text: A news helicopter has crashed in a heavily populated area and civilians are in danger! Evacuate them before the chopper explodes and any more lives are lost.

rainy.name: Burning Building
rainy.text: Forced Response: After the villain phase begins, deal 1 indirect damage to each player. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero and spend a [physical] resource → discard Burning Building.

rainy.name: Wounded Civilians
rainy.text: Uses (1 [per_player] civilian counters). Interrupt: When a player would heal damage from a character, remove 1 civilian counter from here instead.

rainy.name: Catastrophic Collision
rainy.text: Peril. When Revealed: Choose one: • Deal 2 [per_player] indirect damage to the players. This damage gains piercing. • Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card. • Each player discards the highest-cost card from their hand.

rainy.name: Innocent Bystander
rainy.text: Attach to your identity. You get -1 hand size. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero → discard this card and remove 1 threat from a scheme. [star] Boost: Place 2 threat on the main scheme.
